facts.fact: The queen met Asha once at the Kolathur fair, where Asha argued with her over the price of pepper-sacks and was right.
Lata (Third Guard), who refused her page, rode north with Usha's riders and is already on the shelf while the queen's column arrives; the other seven who refused ride with the queen.
The queen knows the eleventh step of the west stair from Rema's roll, which took down the physician Eravi's account of the postern and the eleventh step; she does not use any key.
